stem: Orbit Claims runs many short-lived Lambda database calls and sees connection-limit alarms plus failover disruption during Multi-AZ events.

choices.text: Increase DB instance size and keep direct client connections unchanged.
Place Amazon RDS Proxy in front of the database for connection pooling.
Keep direct connections and add one read replica for each AZ.
Reduce DNS TTL values and leave connection fan-out unchanged.

rationale: RDS Proxy addresses high connection churn by pooling and reusing backend connections and can reduce failover disruption. Instance upsizing can help capacity but does not directly solve connection storm behavior. Read replicas target read scaling, not connection pooling for write paths. DNS tuning can help endpoint refresh behavior but does not replace connection pooling logic.
